newsitem.title: BRAZIL: FTAA ministers to meet in Costa Rica next February.
newsitem.headline: FTAA ministers to meet in Costa Rica next February.

text.p: The 34 signatory countries of the Free Trade Area of the Americas (FTAA) will hold a ministerial meeting next year in San Jose, the capital of Costa Rica, officials said on Wednesday.
Brazilian and U.S. officials said the meeting of trade and foreign ministers would take place in February 1998, before a March presidential summit scheduled for Santiago, Chile.
Peter Allgeier, the chief U.S. negotiator for the FTAA, said an exact date for the Costa Rican talks had not yet been set. At least three preparatory meetings will proceed the ministerial session.
Leaders of 34 countries in the Americas, excluding Cuba, decided at a Miami summit in 1994 to set up a free trade zone by the year 2005.
Officials were meeting in Rio de Janeiro to prepare for a May 15-16 ministerial summit in the Brazilian city of Belo Horizonte.
